summary.candidate_pool_scope: complete original <=600 Da pool regardless of old split; no extra lipid anchor, current tokenizer; no new C/N/S or halogen bans

method.algorithm: coverage-aware facility-location coreset plus diversity and mass/P balance

coreset.sampling: uniform without replacement, plus diversity proposal

method.balance: mass150Da bins x P_count, square-root candidate-population targets, maximum 1.25 bonus
method.historical_splits: ignored for selection at user's direction; files preserved, future evaluation must be redesigned
method.normalization: terminal phosphate-O protonation comparison only; no changed labels
method.self_match: each target's own phosphate-protonation group excluded from all nearest distances
